provenance.accent-pin: Salt's editable-borderColor-hover/-active resolve through palette-accent*, which carries a data-accent axis (blue default, teal alternate — next/palette/accent.css). This column pins BLUE, Salt's default, the same scope trim button.salt.json made; only calendar.salt.json models byAccent so far. Recorded, not modelled.
provenance.field-bg: Input.css background: var(--saltInput-background, var(--input-background)); .saltInput-primary { --input-background: var(--salt-editable-primary-background) } -> next/characteristics/editable.css -> palette-background-primary -> next/palette/background.css: color-background-snow light / color-background-jet dark -> next/foundations/color.css snow-rgb 255,255,255 / jet-rgb 16,24,32
provenance.field-bg-secondary / field-bg-tertiary: .saltInput-secondary / .saltInput-tertiary { --input-background: var(--salt-editable-{secondary,tertiary}-background) } -> editable.css -> palette-background-{secondary,tertiary} -> marble 245,247,248 / limestone 250,248,242 light; granite 26,34,41 / leather 38,41,43 dark
provenance.field-bg-readonly: editable.css --salt-editable-background-readonly: var(--salt-color-transparent) -> foundations/color.css: transparent. Salt's read-only input has NO background of its own — it dissolves into whatever is behind it.
provenance.fg / fg-disabled: Input.css color: var(--saltInput-color, var(--salt-content-primary-foreground)) and --saltInput-color-disabled fallback var(--salt-content-primary-foreground-disabled) -> next/characteristics/content.css -> palette-foreground-primary(-disabled) -> foundations/color.css black/white + next/foundations/alpha.css black-40a/white-40a
provenance.placeholder-fg: .saltInput-input::placeholder { color: var(--salt-content-secondary-foreground); font-weight: var(--salt-text-fontWeight-small) } -> content.css -> palette-foreground-secondary -> gray-700 (76,81,87) light / gray-300 (177,181,185) dark. The WEIGHT token resolves through next/characteristics/text.css --salt-text-fontWeight-small -> typography fontWeight-light = 300.
provenance.border: .saltInput-{variant} { --input-borderColor: var(--salt-editable-borderColor) } -> next/characteristics/editable.css -> palette-neutral -> next/palette/neutral.css: color-gray-500 in BOTH light and dark blocks -> gray-500-rgb 114,119,125. Mode-invariant by Salt's own definition, not by our assumption.
provenance.border-hover: editable-borderColor-hover -> palette-accent -> color-blue-500 in BOTH light and dark accent blocks -> blue-500-rgb 0,120,207. Mode-invariant.
provenance.border-active: editable-borderColor-active -> palette-accent-stronger -> blue-700 (0,69,126) light / blue-300 (154,189,245) dark. ALSO the value of --salt-focused-outlineColor (next/characteristics/focused.css), which is why style.root.focus aliases the same stop through the outline-current indirection.
provenance.border-readonly / border-disabled: editable-borderColor-readonly -> palette-neutral-readonly -> gray-500-10a; editable-borderColor-disabled -> palette-neutral-disabled -> gray-500-40a (next/foundations/alpha.css). Both identical in light and dark.
provenance.status-*: Input.css .saltInput-{error,warning,success} { --input-borderColor: var(--salt-status-{s}-borderColor) } -> next/characteristics/status.css -> palette-{negative,warning,positive} -> red-500 229,33,53 / orange-500 199,83,0 / green-500 0,135,93. All mode-invariant (the 500 stop is identical in both blocks), matching alert.salt.json's already-extracted values exactly. The SAME palette-{role} token is what StatusAdornment.css's --statusAdornment-color resolves to (via status-{s}-foreground-decorative), which is why style.status-adornment.color aliases border-current rather than getting its own slot.
provenance.status-*-bg: .saltInput-{s} { --input-background: var(--salt-status-{s}-background) } -> status.css -> palette-{role}-weakest -> the 100 stop light / 900 stop dark: red 255,236,234 / 69,0,2; orange 255,236,217 / 66,32,0; green 234,245,242 / 0,41,21
provenance.byDensity.control-height: Input.css height/min-height: var(--saltInput-height, var(--salt-size-base)) -> foundations/size.css: 20/28/36/44px (docs/foundations/sizes.md control-height row)
provenance.byDensity.field-padding: Input.css padding-left/padding-right: var(--salt-spacing-100); there is NO vertical padding declaration at all — height alone sets the vertical rhythm. spacing-100 = 4/8/12/16px (docs/foundations/spacing.md unit row)
provenance.byDensity.field-gap: one token, three uses: .saltInput-startAdornmentContainer padding-right, .saltInput-endAdornmentContainer padding-left, both containers' column-gap, and .saltStatusAdornment padding-left — all var(--salt-spacing-100)
provenance.byDensity.corner-weak: Input.css border-radius: var(--salt-palette-corner-weak, 0) -> next/palette/corner.css [data-corner="rounded"] -> curve-100 -> foundations/curve.css 2/4/6/8px. Same rounded-edition pin as button/tooltip (docs/foundations/shape.md).
provenance.byDensity.type-body: Input.css font-family var(--salt-text-fontFamily) (Open Sans), font-size var(--salt-text-fontSize), line-height var(--salt-text-lineHeight) -> next/characteristics/text.css body block, density-scaled (docs/foundations/typography.md). NOTE: Input.css does NOT declare font-weight; the 400 in this shorthand is the ambient --salt-text-fontWeight (typography fontWeight-regular), recorded rather than invented.
provenance.byDensity.adornment-size: StatusAdornment.css height/min-height: var(--salt-size-adornment) -> foundations/size.css 6/8/10/12px (docs/foundations/sizes.md adornment row). Checked against TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md's frozen-token lesson: already a density token in source, not a literal.
provenance.byDensity.adornment-button-height: DECLARED COMPOSITION. Input.css .saltInput-{start,end}AdornmentContainer > .saltButton { --saltButton-height: calc(var(--salt-size-base) - var(--salt-spacing-100)) } = 20-4 / 28-8 / 36-12 / 44-16 = 16/20/24/28px. Salt also sets --saltButton-padding: calc(spacing-50 - button-borderWidth) and --saltButton-borderRadius: palette-corner-weaker on those buttons; both belong to the button component's own matrix, not duplicated here.
provenance.border-width-literals: 1px = --salt-size-fixed-100, 2px = --salt-size-fixed-200 (foundations/size.css). Kept as literals deliberately: the fixed scale is density-INVARIANT by design (docs/foundations/sizes.md: 'fixed scale ... 1px-9px, density-invariant, all 5 densities identical'), so these are not frozen snapshots of a scaling token.
provenance.min-width-literal: Input.css min-width: var(--saltInput-minWidth, 4em) — a hardcoded default with an override point. Kept as a literal: it is em-relative, so it already tracks the density-driven font size (unlike a bare px literal, which is the case TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md's lesson was about).
provenance.focus-outline: Input.css outline: var(--saltInput-outline, var(--salt-focused-outlineWidth) var(--salt-focused-outlineStyle) var(--input-outlineColor)) -> next/characteristics/focused.css: outlineWidth = size-fixed-200 = 2px, outlineStyle = borderStyle-dotted = dotted (foundations/borderStyle.css), outlineColor = palette-accent-stronger, reassigned to the status colour by .saltInput-{status}
provenance.cursors: foundations/cursor.css: --salt-cursor-text: text (rest and focused), --salt-cursor-disabled: not-allowed, --salt-cursor-readonly: text. Note cursor-readonly resolves to the SAME value as cursor-text, so Salt's read-only cursor is a tokenised distinction with no visual consequence — recorded, not given a row.
provenance.no-shadow-no-motion: Input.css contains no box-shadow, no transition and no animation rule anywhere — confirmed absences by full-file read, not unfound values.
provenance.form-field-context: Input.tsx useFormFieldProps(): isDisabled = disabled || formFieldDisabled; isReadOnly = readOnlyProp || formFieldReadOnly; validationStatus = formFieldValidationStatus ?? validationStatusProp (context WINS over the instance prop, unlike the two OR-ed booleans). a11yProps supply aria-labelledby/aria-describedby, merged with inputProps' own via clsx. FormFieldContext.ts / useFormFieldProps.ts.
provenance.validation-enum: InputProps.validationStatus?: FormFieldValidationStatus -> FormFieldContext.ts: `interface FormFieldValidationStatuses extends Omit<ValidationStatuses,'info'>` -> status-indicator/ValidationStatus.ts ValidationStatuses = {error,warning,success,info}. So Input's enum is error|warning|success — info is deliberately excluded, even though Salt's Banner and Tooltip both accept it.

structure.root-wrapper.source: Input.tsx renders <div class="saltInput"> containing the adornment containers, <input class="saltInput-input">, the StatusAdornment and <div class="saltInput-activationIndicator">

structure.indicator.note: ordered with the real default first. Input.tsx: `bordered = false` — so Salt's out-of-the-box input is an UNDERLINE (.saltInput-activationIndicator, always rendered), and the full box border is the opt-in .saltInput-bordered. Input.css lines 27-53 (box) vs 55-94 (indicator).
structure.indicator.source: Input.tsx bordered?: boolean, default false; Input.css .saltInput-bordered / .saltInput-activationIndicator

structure.status-adornment.source: Input.tsx: {!isDisabled && validationStatus && <StatusAdornment status={validationStatus} />} — inserted by the component itself, note the explicit suppression while disabled

behavior.status-inheritance.source: Input.tsx useFormFieldProps() — see the form-field-context provenance entry for the exact (non-uniform) precedence rules

behavior.empty-readonly-marker.source: Input.tsx emptyReadOnlyMarker = "—"; isEmptyReadOnlyValue() treats null/undefined/''/[] as empty and substitutes the marker for the value

prop.validation-status.note: info is NOT in this enum — see the validation-enum provenance entry

prop.text-align.source: Input.tsx textAlign = "left", written as an inline --input-textAlign custom property that .saltInput-input's text-align reads

prop.disabled.source: Input.tsx disabled (also OR-ed with form-field context)

prop.read-only.source: Input.tsx readOnly (also OR-ed with form-field context); .saltInput-readOnly has its own background, border colour and cursor

style.root.background@box.note: `bordered` changes the border and nothing else — the background is untouched. A real non-variation, confirmed by reading .saltInput-bordered (Input.css 27-53): it declares border only.

style.root.shape@box.note: corner radius is independent of `bordered` — one border-radius declaration on .saltInput serves both

style.root.cursor.source: Input.css .saltInput:hover { cursor: var(--salt-cursor-text) } and .saltInput-focused { cursor: var(--salt-cursor-text) }

style.root.shadow.note: no box-shadow anywhere in Input.css — a confirmed absence

style.root.transition.note: no transition and no animation rule anywhere in Input.css — the same total absence TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md found on Salt's tooltip

style.control.placeholder.note: DECLARED RENDERING APPROXIMATION: weight 300 (fontWeight-light) is source-true but this repo self-hosts Open Sans at 400/600 only, so the browser resolves 300 to the 400 face. The sourced value is kept; the shortfall is declared rather than silently rounded.

style.control.caret-color.note: no caret-color declaration in Input.css — the platform default applies

style.indicator.border@underline.source: Input.css .saltInput-activationIndicator { border-bottom: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) var(--salt-borderStyle-solid) var(--input-borderColor) } — the SAME indirection the box border reads, so one status reassignment recolours both

style.root.border@box-focus.source: Input.css .saltInput-bordered.saltInput-focused { border-color: var(--input-borderColor-active) } — recolour only, width unchanged

style.indicator.border@underline-focus.source: Input.css .saltInput-focused .saltInput-activationIndicator { border-bottom: var(--salt-size-fixed-200) var(--salt-borderStyle-solid) var(--input-borderColor-active) } — 1px -> 2px, the same thickening M3's filled field does with the same numbers

style.indicator.border@box-focus.source: Input.css: .saltInput-bordered .saltInput-activationIndicator { border-bottom-width: 0 } EXCEPT .saltInput-bordered.saltInput-focused .saltInput-activationIndicator { border-bottom-width: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) } — the indicator returns at 1px on top of the box border when a bordered input is focused

style.root.focus.source: Input.css .saltInput-focused { outline: var(--salt-focused-outlineWidth) var(--salt-focused-outlineStyle) var(--input-outlineColor) } -> 2px dotted, colour = accent-stronger or the status colour

style.adornment.size.note: DECLARED COMPOSITION — this is Salt sizing a composed Button, not an icon; see the byDensity.adornment-button-height provenance entry

style.status-adornment.color.note: aliased to the border indirection because in source they resolve to the identical value: --statusAdornment-color -> status-{s}-foreground-decorative -> palette-{role}, and --input-borderColor -> status-{s}-borderColor -> the same palette-{role}

style.root.status@error.source: Input.css .saltInput-error { --input-background; --input-background-readonly; --input-borderColor; --input-borderColor-active; --input-borderColor-hover; --input-outlineColor } — six properties in one block, reproduced one-for-one
